The '''Manpha system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Seitia sector/Legends|Seitia sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the planet [[Manpha/Legends|Manpha]].
